Home.title: Studybook
Home.tagline: Learning communities where people actually follow through.

SignUp.title: Create your account
SignUp.intro: Join or create learning groups. We'll email you a code to verify your address.
SignUp.pseudoHint: What other members see. 3 to 30 letters, digits, _ . or -
SignUp.acceptPrivacy: I have read and accept the <link>privacy policy</link>

VerifyEmail.title: Verify your email
VerifyEmail.intro: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.
VerifyEmail.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 30 minutes.
VerifyEmail.resent: If {email} is waiting for verification, a new code is on its way.
VerifyEmail.verifiedNext: Your account is active. You can now log in.

fields.taken: One of these values was just taken. Please try again.

pseudo.invalid_format: Use 3 to 30 letters, digits, _ . or - (no spaces).

email.taken: An account already uses this email.

phone.taken: An account already uses this number.

acceptPrivacy.invalid_value: You need to accept the privacy policy to create an account.

newEmail.taken: An account already uses this email.

api.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.

api.VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Ask for a new one below.
api.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

Login.title: Log in
Login.notVerified: Your email isn't verified yet. Enter the code we emailed you, or ask for a new one.
Login.googleFailed: Google login did not work. Please try again.
Login.googleSuspended: This account is suspended. Contact the administrator of this server.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
ForgotPassword.intro: Enter your account's email. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If an account uses {email}, a link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.doneNext: For your safety, you were logged out on every device. Log in with your new password.
ResetPassword.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.currentPasswordHint: To make sure it is really you
Profile.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Your email changes once you enter it.

Google.signupIntro: Google confirmed your email. Choose a pseudo and add your phone number.
Google.expired: This step has expired. Please start again with Google.
Google.useEmail: Sign up with an email instead

Groups.title: My groups
Groups.emptyTitle: You're not in any group yet.
Groups.emptyText: Create one and invite people, or open an invite link someone shared with you.
Groups.archivedNotice: This group is archived: you can read everything, but nothing can be changed.
Groups.newIntro: You will be its leader. You can change all of this later.
Groups.name: Name
Groups.descriptionHint: What the group is about, and what members will do.
Groups.languageLabelHint: Shown as a label, e.g. "Français" or "English". Each member still sees Studybook in their own language.

GroupSettings.title: Group settings
GroupSettings.visibilityPrivateHint: Only people with the invite link can join.
GroupSettings.visibilityListedHint: Anyone can see its name and description and ask to join. You accept or refuse.
GroupSettings.progressAllHint: A points board with pseudos only. Never names, contacts, or proof.
GroupSettings.inviteApproval: Approve people who use the invite link
GroupSettings.archivedReadOnly: This group is archived, so its settings are read-only. Unarchive it to change them.
GroupSettings.archiveHint: Archiving makes the group read-only. You can undo it at any time.
GroupSettings.unarchiveHint: Unarchiving lets members act in the group again.
GroupSettings.deleteHint: Deleting removes the group, its content, and its members for good.
GroupSettings.deleteConfirm: To delete, type the group name: {name}

Join.loggedOut: Create an account or log in to join. You will come back here after.
Join.pending: Your request was sent. You will be in the group once the leader accepts it.
Join.invalidTitle: This invite link no longer works
Join.invalidText: The leader may have reset it. Ask them for the new link.

Invite.title: Invite people
Invite.hint: Anyone with this link can join (or ask to, if you approve new members).
Invite.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the link and copy it by hand.
Invite.resetConfirm: The current link will stop working, including for people you already sent it to.
Invite.resetDone: New link ready. The old one no longer works.

JoinRequests.title: {count, plural, one {# person wants to join} other {# people want to join}}

Members.title: Members
Members.transferConfirm: {pseudo} becomes the leader, with full control. You stay in the group as a moderator.
Members.removeConfirm: {pseudo} leaves the group. They can come back with the invite link.
Members.banConfirm: {pseudo} leaves the group and can't come back, with the link or a request.
Members.leaveConfirm: You will no longer see the group. Your past submissions stay visible to the leader.
